name: shader-loader
description: Lets Claude read, improve, compile and capture the shaders loaded in the Shader Loader plugin for Resolume Arena.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Shader Loader FFGL plugin running in Resolume Arena on this computer. Claude can read the loaded shader, rewrite it from your request, compile and apply it live, look at the rendered output and save it to your library. Everything stays on this computer (local named pipe).

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List Shader Loader instances in Resolume

tools.name: get_shader
tools.description: Read the loaded shader (passes, channels, sliders)

tools.name: update_shader
tools.description: Compile and apply new shader code live

tools.name: save_shader
tools.description: Save the shader to the library

prompts.name: ameliorer_effet
prompts.description: Améliore l'effet chargé selon une consigne
prompts.text: Améliore l'effet chargé dans Shader Loader (Resolume) : ${arguments.consigne}
